interpretation: The tenant-per-graph layout stayed under 100 ms p99 through offered concurrency 64 across these three local samples, but all three concurrency-128 phases missed (146–158 ms). The shared graph layout was also under 100 ms through 32; at 64 one of three trials reached 101 ms, and all three 128 phases missed (140–159 ms). All 3,072 reads completed exactly, but this finite local sample is not a service availability/SLO estimate, does not establish hosted latency, and does not establish unbounded capacity.
limitations: Three closed-loop Miniflare/SQLite trials on one machine; in-process Worker RPC latency is not external or hosted caller latency.
No open-loop offered arrival-rate model, repeated time windows, fault injection, mixed writes, multi-region placement or single-hot-tenant phase.
Each tenant graph has its own transaction history; cross-graph transactions/consistent fanout are not evaluated.
Seed transaction shapes differ: one 512-fact shared transaction versus 128 four-fact tenant transactions.
